lines.text: The trick: seventy-two is three twos and two threes. Count each prime alone.

lines.text: For the twos, each number has zero to three. One needs all three: seven squares.

lines.text: For the threes, zero to two. One needs both: five squares.

lines.text: Now multiply the choices: seven times five is thirty-five!
